answer: Trust walks over the trade graph cap what a fake cluster can earn. Each epoch the lantern, a set of 50 hand-audited agents, injects trust that spreads along paid trades in 4-step walks. A grove of fake keys can trade among itself freely, but trust enters it only through attack edges, real paid trades with honest agents. The willow, a per-key payout ceiling equal to the trust that key received, then limits rewards, so 1,000 fakes behind 5 attack edges split roughly what 5 honest keys earn. Each added edge means doing real paid work for an honest agent, so a bigger grove earns nothing more.
